1) Joining the Waitlist: If a class is fully booked, you can add yourself to the waiting list for that class. This process is similar to booking a class.

items.title: What is the no-show policy for classes & free services?
items.body:
What is the no-show policy for classes & free services? Yes, there is a no-show policy in place for missed classes. Here's how it works:

What counts as a no-show: A no-show occurs when you fail to attend a scheduled class without cancelling your booking at least 1 hour before the class start time.
How the policy works:
- 1st no-show: You'll receive a warning email.
-2nd no-show: A 2-week class booking restriction is applied.
-Every no-show after that: A further 2-week restriction is applied.

What a booking restriction means: During a restriction, you're still welcome to attend classes. However, you won't be able to book in advance; instead, please check with the front desk before the class to see if a spot is available.

You'll receive an automated alert after your first no-show (warning) and whenever a booking restriction is applied.

We encourage all members to cancel in advance if they can't attend, to avoid restrictions and give others the opportunity to participate.

items.title: Why does the date format look incorrect in my TrainMore app?
items.body:
Why does the date format look incorrect in my TrainMore app? If the date format in your TrainMore app looks different from what you expect (for example, showing MM/DD/YYYY instead of DD/MM/YYYY), this is determined by your phone’s Language & Region settings.

The TrainMore app automatically uses the date format associated with your device’s language settings.
To display dates in the DD/MM/YYYY format, please adjust your device language accordingly. Note that the date format will change automatically based on your selected language. For example:
If English (US) is selected, then the formal will be MM/DD/YYY. If English (UK) is selected, then the format will be DD/MM/YYY. 

For iPhone (iOS):
Open Settings on your iPhone.Go to General → Language & Region.Tap Add Language under Preferred Languages.Add English (UK) from the list and set it as your primary language. Close and reopen the TrainMore app.

For Android:
Open Settings on your Android phone.Go to General management → Language.Tap Add language, then choose English (United Kingdom).Move English (United Kingdom) to the top of the list to set it as your main language.Close and reopen the TrainMore app.

Once your phone’s region is set to English (UK) or another language that shares the same date format, the app will automatically display dates in DD/MM/YYYY format.

items.title: How does the euro discount per workout work?
items.body:
How does the euro discount per workout work? Members of TrainMore with a Flex, 1-year, 2-year (or 3-year membership) receive euro discount per successful visit.

This discount is deducted from the automatic debit of the next 4-week period. 
Please note, you will not build up any visit discount during a free promotional period, and your first membership fee payment will not include any visit discount. 

If you cancel your membership (which we hope you won’t, of course), you will no longer receive a discount after your last payment, as there will be no more automatic debits to apply the discount to.

Your workouts are automatically tracked and converted into discounts for the next period, only when you check-in using your QR code from the TrainMore app.

You can accumulate a maximum discount of 1 check-in per day. Multiple visits per day do not result in additional discounts. Also, there must be at least 30 minutes between the check-in and check-out times to receive a visit discount.

To see how much discount you’ve accumulated, go to the TrainMore app > Studio > Self-service > Check-in History.
Make sure to check the date range of your current 4-week period and count your check-ins within this timeframe. This will give you an estimate of the discount applied to your next payment.

Please note that the app shows your number of check-ins per month, while your membership is billed every 4 weeks. This means that your total number of check-ins per month may sometimes be spread across two billing periods. As a result, the calculation of your euro discount may not perfectly align with the numbers you see per month.  

For more information about the euro discount click here (https://trainmore.com/en-NL/1-euro-discount).

items.title: Why does the date format look incorrect in my TrainMore app?
items.body:
Why does the date format look incorrect in my TrainMore app? If the date format in your TrainMore app looks different from what you expect (for example, showing MM/DD/YYYY instead of DD/MM/YYYY), this is determined by your phone’s Language & Region settings.

The TrainMore app automatically uses the date format associated with your device’s language settings.
To display dates in the DD/MM/YYYY format, please adjust your device language accordingly. Note that the date format will change automatically based on your selected language. For example:
If English (US) is selected, then the formal will be MM/DD/YYY. If English (UK) is selected, then the format will be DD/MM/YYY. 

For iPhone (iOS):
Open Settings on your iPhone.Go to General → Language & Region.Tap Add Language under Preferred Languages.Add English (UK) from the list and set it as your primary language. Close and reopen the TrainMore app.

For Android:
Open Settings on your Android phone.Go to General management → Language.Tap Add language, then choose English (United Kingdom).Move English (United Kingdom) to the top of the list to set it as your main language.Close and reopen the TrainMore app.

Once your phone’s region is set to English (UK) or another language that shares the same date format, the app will automatically display dates in DD/MM/YYYY format.

items.title: How do I know if my club has independent Personal Trainers or TrainMore-employed trainers?
items.body:
How do I know if my club has independent Personal Trainers or TrainMore-employed trainers? You can find out the Personal Training offerings at your club in a few ways:

Ask at the host desk in your clubCheck the club website (trainers will be listed if available)Look at in-club screens (narrowcasting) 
If a club does not currently show Personal Trainers online or in-club, it may mean trainers are not present yet. Trainer availability can change as new trainers join or leave.

items.title: Can I attend Personal Training at another club?
items.body:
Can I attend Personal Training at another club? Yes. If you have access to multiple clubs, you can train with a Personal Trainer at a club that is not your home club. 

You may book an intake and purchase PT packages or memberships at another club if they work with contracted (TrainMore-employed) trainers, provided you have access to that club 

If the club has independent Personal Trainers, you can also train with them directly, provided you have access to that club. 

Availability and booking methods may differ depending on the type of trainer at the club you want to enjoy Personal Training.

items.title: My club has independent Personal Training - How do I manage my Personal Training?
items.body:
My club has independent Personal Training - How do I manage my Personal Training? If your club works with independent Personal Trainers: 

You schedule sessions directly with your Personal Trainer, not through the app. Their contact details are available at the front desk, on the website, and via narrowcasting in the club. All questions about your payment schedule, training, progress, and planning are handled directly between you and your trainer. 

If there is ever something you feel uncomfortable discussing with your trainer, you’re always more than welcome to reach out to the club manager.

items.title: Can I buy a daypass?
items.body:
Can I buy a daypass? Yes, you can purchase a day pass at any TrainMore club.

The price ranges from €20 to €30, depending on the specific club and its label.

Please note that our clubs do not accept cash payments - you can pay by card only.

items.title: I am under 18 — can I change or cancel my membership myself?
items.body: I am under 18 — can I change or cancel my membership myself? No. If you are under 18 we cannot process a change or cancellation without consent from a parent or legal guardian. Please visit your home club together with your parent or legal representative, who can request the change on your behalf so we can obtain the necessary authorisation.

items.body: What access do the different membership levels give me? Red Label: access to 1 Red Label club plus all Black Label and Regular Label clubs. PREMIUM Black Label: access to all Black Label clubs and all Regular Label clubs. HOME+ Black Label: access to 1 Black Label club plus all Regular Label clubs.

items.title: Why do my check-ins in the app not match my discount?
items.body: Why do my check-ins in the app not match my discount? The app and the recap show check-ins per calendar month, while billing runs every 4 weeks. Your check-ins can therefore be spread across two billing periods, so the discount deducted may not exactly match the number of check-ins you see for that month in the app.
